title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 1: the greeting to Corinth, the contentions over leaders, and the foolishness of God that is wiser than men.

questions.text: Who is named together with Paul in the opening verse?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:1 names Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes.

questions.text: To which assembly is the letter addressed?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:2 addresses the assembly of God which is at Corinth, those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called saints.

answers.text: The assembly of God which is at Corinth

questions.text: In what were they enriched in Christ Jesus?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:5 says that in everything they were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge.

answers.text: In all speech and all knowledge
In silver and gold from the Gentiles
In lands and houses in every place
In signs and wonders among the nations

questions.text: Whose household reported the contentions among them?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:11 says it was reported to him by those who are from Chloe's household that there are contentions among them.

questions.text: Besides Paul, Apollos and Christ, whom did some of them say they followed?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:12 says each one was saying, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

questions.text: Apart from the household of Stephanas, whom does Paul say he baptized?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:14-16 say he baptized none of them except Crispus and Gaius, and adds that he also baptized the household of Stephanas.

questions.text: What is the word of the cross to those who are dying?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:18 says the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

questions.text: What do Jews ask for and what do Greeks seek, according to the text?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:22 says that Jews ask for signs and Greeks seek after wisdom.

answers.text: Jews ask for wisdom, Greeks seek after signs
Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom

questions.text: The foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is what?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:25 says the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

questions.text: What is written about the one who boasts?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:31 says that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

answers.text: “He who boasts will be put to shame.”
“Let him boast in his own work.”
“He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
